definitions.explanation: A small mammal of the Americas whose body is covered with bony, armor-like plates. Some kinds, such as the three-banded armadillo, roll up into a ball when threatened.

examples.japanese: アルマジロ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{硬|かた}い→硬い：01116_katai⟧。
アルマジロ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{丸|まる}く→丸い：02967_marui⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The armadillo rolled up into a ball.

examples.japanese: アルマジロ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{危険|きけん}→危険：01141_kiken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{硬|かた}い→硬い：01116_katai⟧⟦{甲羅|こうら}→甲羅：21848_koura⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}る→守る：01986_mamoru⟧。
examples.english: When an armadillo senses danger, it protects itself with its hard shell.

notes:
The name comes from Spanish armadillo, "little armored one".

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ダンゴムシ→ダンゴムシ：32612_dangomushi⟧: pill bug — also rolls into a ball, a common comparison in Japanese
- センザンコウ: pangolin — covered with scales rather than plates
